summary: December brings Christmas markets and snow in the north, and the start of summer in the south.
intro: Christmas markets fill the squares of Germany, Austria and central Europe, and the ski resorts open in the Alps and Scandinavia. The northern nights are at their longest, which suits the northern lights.

South of the equator summer begins, with beach weather in Australia, South Africa and South America, and the dry season goes on across much of tropical Asia and Central America. The holidays at the end of the month push up prices nearly everywhere.
